home.heroSubtitle: Platform of fashion, business and culture of Zakarpattia
home.aboutText1: FWU Platform is an ecosystem that unites designers, models, entrepreneurs and cultural figures of Zakarpattia. We create a space where fashion becomes a tool for regional development, and every participant gains access to B2B solutions, educational programs and world-class events.
home.aboutText2: Our mission is to feel and reflect the potential of Zakarpattia through fashion, objects, people and senses. A platform for those who shape the identity of the region.
home.case1Quote: FWU helped me enter the B2B market and find my first wholesale clients outside the region.
home.case2Quote: Thanks to the platform, I found unique local designers that I now represent in my store.
home.case3Quote: Scouting through FWU opened the door to professional modeling for me. I got my first contract within a month.
